profile.visual_desc: Athletic human woman in a dark blue sleeveless tunic, red sash, and black baggy pants. She wears dark fingerless gloves and has voluminous blonde hair tied in a high ponytail.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Fierce female face with sharp eyes and red lips. Thick blonde bangs partially cover her left eye, set in a stern, focused expression for combat.
profile.weapon_desc: Unarmed strikes using her right fist, enhanced by a glowing orange energy aura.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. She holds a low, centered stance with fists raised and back turned slightly toward the viewer.
profile.step2_windup: She jabs forward with an energy-coated fist, then coils her body back deeply to prepare a powerful upward swing.
profile.step3_impact: A massive upward right-hand punch creates a large, pale-yellow crescent energy wave sweeping from bottom-right toward the top-left target.
profile.step4_finish: She holds the high follow-through pose as the energy trail dissipates, then relaxes back into her initial combat stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The energy arc in Frame 4 must strictly follow the wide upward diagonal path of the right fist, curving toward the top-left.
